caption: A punch lands in the ring.
spoken: A punch lands in the ring.

caption: On the broadcast, that punch lands five seconds later.
spoken: On the broadcast, that punch lands five seconds later.

caption: In those five seconds, anyone watching faster already knows the price is wrong.
spoken: In those five seconds, anyone watching faster already knows the price is wrong.

caption: Sportsbooks call it courtsiding, and they answer it by freezing the market.
spoken: Sportsbooks call it courtsiding, and they answer it by freezing the market.

caption: Ringside answers it with the clock.
spoken: Ringside answers it with the clock.

caption: Ringside is an in-play fight exchange on Solana. The fight and the order book run inside the same MagicBlock ephemeral rollup, ten ticks a second.
spoken: Ringside is an in play fight exchange on Solana. The fight and the order book run inside the same MagicBlock ephemeral rollup, ten ticks a second.

caption: Every order is stamped with the tick it was priced on. If the fight has moved on, the program refuses the order.
spoken: Every order is stamped with the tick it was priced on. If the fight has moved on, the program refuses the order.

caption: Here is a real devnet match, at its biggest hit. Red lands, and the fair price jumps in the same tick.
spoken: Here is a real dev-net match, at its biggest hit. Red lands, and the fair price jumps in the same tick.

caption: A bot watching the five-second TV feed sends the old price. On a delayed book, it fills. On Ringside, the same order is rejected onchain.
spoken: A bot watching the five-second TV feed sends the old price. On a delayed book, it fills. On Ringside, the same order is rejected on-chain.

caption: Tonight's card lists every live bout. AI fighters, trained by self-play, run in the lobby around the clock, and you can challenge one yourself.
spoken: Tonight's card lists every live bout. AI fighters, trained by self-play, run in the lobby around the clock, and you can challenge one yourself.

caption: Inside a match, the odds move with every hit. In a load test of 8 bots, fills confirmed in 262 milliseconds at the median.
spoken: Inside a match, the odds move with every hit. In a load test of 8 bots, fills confirmed in 262 milliseconds at the median.

caption: Positions live in a private rollup inside a TEE. Nobody else can read yours until the bell.
spoken: Positions live in a private rollup inside a T E E. Nobody else can read yours until the bell.

caption: At the bell, settlement pays the winner, reveals every position, and writes the match record to Solana.
spoken: At the bell, settlement pays the winner, reveals every position, and writes the match record to Solana.

caption: Then anyone can replay the match in their browser. Press verify, and it re-runs every tick and checks the hash chain written onchain.
spoken: Then anyone can replay the match in their browser. Press verify, and it re-runs every tick and checks the hash chain written on-chain.

caption: Under the hood, the fight and the book are one ephemeral rollup, cranked every hundred milliseconds.
spoken: Under the hood, the fight and the book are one ephemeral rollup, cranked every hundred milliseconds.

caption: MagicBlock VRF seeds the power-ups. Session keys sign every move. The private rollup seals each position. And Magic Actions write the result back to Solana.
spoken: MagicBlock V R F seeds the power-ups. Session keys sign every move. The private rollup seals each position. And Magic Actions write the result back to Solana.

caption: We measured it on devnet. Across 23 held-out matches, the delayed book accepted 319 stale fills. Ringside accepted zero, and rejected 1,283 stale orders onchain.
spoken: We measured it on dev-net. Across 23 held-out matches, the delayed book accepted 319 stale fills. Ringside accepted zero, and rejected 1,283 stale orders on-chain.

caption: Ticks landed every 100 milliseconds at the median. 60 of 60 private reads were denied. And 19 of 19 replays verified, 10,266 ticks checked.
spoken: Ticks landed every 100 milliseconds at the median. 60 of 60 private reads were denied. And 19 of 19 replays verified, 10,266 ticks checked.

caption: A punch lands, and the price moves in the same instruction. There is no gap left to trade.
spoken: A punch lands, and the price moves in the same instruction. There is no gap left to trade.

caption: Ringside. Live on devnet, open source, and ready for the next fight.
spoken: Ringside. Live on dev-net, open source, and ready for the next fight.
